sentences.en: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.
sentences.zh: 几片枯叶漂浮在池塘上。

sentences.en: These fragments belong to a vase which has unfortunately smashed.
sentences.zh: 这些碎片属于一个不幸摔碎的花瓶。

sentences.en: These fragments belong to a vase which has broken, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 这些碎片来自一个不幸破碎的花瓶。

senses.zh: 碎片；片断或不完整部分 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：frag（破碎）+ment（结果）→碎片
